# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and Skia m151** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates to Skia milestone m151 and ships a focused wave of managed-code performance improvements. Hot paths for SKColor conversion, hex parsing, and SKShaper glyph reading move to zero-allocation managed C#. HarfBuzzSharp buffer encoding becomes allocation-free via pooled UTF-8. WASM gains Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11. A CPU raster regression from the Skia legacy shader context removal is also corrected.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Updated to Skia milestone m151** — The bundled Skia engine advances to m151, bringing upstream stability fixes from Google's chrome/m151 branch. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))
- **CPU raster regression corrected** — SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was inadvertently dropped; restoring it fixes a CPU raster rendering regression affecting non-GPU drawing paths. ([#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **SKColor hex parsing optimized with ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads** — SKColor.Parse and TryParse gain ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads and an optimized hex parser, removing intermediate allocations on hot parse paths. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — The overload that accepts an SKData and an SKRectI crop rect leaked a native reference; it is now correctly released. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM** — Pre-built native WASM libraries compiled with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the new exnref exception-handling model are included for .NET 11 WASM targets. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes to HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1, making Buffer.AddUtf8(string) allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding and removing the per-call char[4] heap allocation in Tag.Parse.

Release Candidate 1 delivered the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, the CPU raster regression fix, the m151 engine sync, and a native resource leak fix in SKImage.FromEncodedData.
